q: ____ is the movement of dissolved substances through a plant.
e: Translocation is the movement of dissolved substances through a plant. The blank is Translocation.

q: In general, water and dissolved salts from the soil travel upwards through the vessels of the xylem and food synthesized in the leaves passes downwards or upwards in the ____ of the phloem.
e: In general, water and dissolved salts from the soil travel upwards through the vessels of the xylem and food synthesized in the leaves passes downwards or upwards in the sieve tubes of the phloem. The blank is sieve tubes.
When leaves photosynthesize, they produce carbohydrates. That missing piece is carbohydrates.

q: These carbohydrates are transported out of the leaf in the form of ____ to the stem.
e: These carbohydrates are transported out of the leaf in the form of sucrose to the stem. That missing piece is sucrose.

q: Once in the stem it may travel upwards to actively growing regions or maturing fruits and seeds or downwards to the roots and underground ____ organs.
e: Once in the stem it may travel upwards to actively growing regions or maturing fruits and seeds or downwards to the roots and underground storage organs. Write storage in the gap.

q: Both upward and downward movement may take place at the ____ time in the phloem.
e: Both upward and downward movement may take place at the same time in the phloem. Write same in the gap.

q: The phloem tissue is a ____ tissue.
e: The phloem tissue is a complex tissue. The blank is complex.

q: The consisting components are sieve tube, ____ cell, phloem parenchyma and phloem fibre.
e: The consisting components are sieve tube, companion cell, phloem parenchyma and phloem fibre. Write companion in the gap.

q: Sieve cells can manage translocation without nuclei because they are kept alive by the nucleated ____ cells that always situated adjacent to sieve cells.
e: Sieve cells can manage translocation without nuclei because they are kept alive by the nucleated companion cells that always situated adjacent to sieve cells. Write companion in the gap.

q: Moreover, phloem tissue is strengthened by ____ cells besides the sieve and companion cells.
e: Moreover, phloem tissue is strengthened by fibre cells besides the sieve and companion cells. Write fibre in the gap.
